sources.title: Continuous Collision
sources.supports: Original developer talk compares speculative contacts, time of impact and conservative advancement, including ghost contacts, lost remainder time and cost tradeoffs.
sources.scope_and_limits: Mostly game and 2D examples; not proof of a complete 3D rotating-aircraft sweep, exact geometry, RC strength or runtime cost.
sources.access_scope: Original presentation, relevant algorithm and tradeoff sections.

sources.title: Modeling Compliant Contact
sources.supports: Describes point-witness and finite-patch limitations, hydroelastic contact, distinct effective modulus, and deformation/velocity-dependent Hunt–Crossley dissipation.
sources.scope_and_limits: Robotics simulator model and numerical parameters; not measured RC surface-pair behavior, strength or a recommended engine replacement.
sources.access_scope: Official documentation; point, hydroelastic and dissipation sections.

sources.title: Hydroelastic Contact User Guide
sources.supports: Pressure distributed over a finite contact interface provides resultant force and moment; representation and geometry resolution affect cost.
sources.scope_and_limits: Model assumes a compliant contact representation; no direct calibrated patch law for the simulator's sparsely sampled hull.
sources.access_scope: Official guide, introduction and representation guidance.

sources.title: Water entry of a body which moves in more than six degrees of freedom
sources.supports: Early-entry analysis for a smooth body in initially calm water uses evolving wetted geometry and arbitrary body kinematics; includes a limited oblique-entry experimental comparison.
sources.scope_and_limits: Early penetration/Wagner assumptions; not validated for RC propellers, arbitrary wing edges, wave fields, cavities, viscosity or sustained planing.
sources.access_scope: Article abstract/introduction and scope; original PMC content was retrieved, later reopens encountered a browser check. Author-institution abstract independently retrieved.

sources.title: Estimation of Hydrodynamic Impact Loads and Pressure Distributions on Bodies Approximating Elliptical Cylinders with Special Reference to Water Landings of Helicopters
sources.supports: NACA-TN-2889 proposes approximate oblique-entry loads for elliptical cylinders and states that comparison data are limited.
sources.scope_and_limits: Original report abstract/metadata inspected; limited rigid-cylinder vertical-drop comparison, not an RC transient-water calibration.
sources.access_scope: NASA original report record and abstract.

sources.title: Engineering: Design Process Used to Develop APC Propellers
sources.supports: Manufacturer separates bending, centrifugal and torsional loads, accounts for structural/dynamic properties, and discusses empirical limitations; geometry data are available for its production propellers.
sources.scope_and_limits: Manufacturer design process, not a crash-nick failure law or permission to redistribute all data. Geometry/phase/strength of each installed propeller still needs authoring and validation.
sources.access_scope: Engineering, geometry-data and structural-theory sections.

sources.title: AC 25.905-1: Minimizing the Hazards from Propeller Blade and Hub Failures
sources.supports: Section 6 describes a released blade centroid moving tangentially, tumbling, phase-dependent intersections and aerodynamic trajectory effects.
sources.scope_and_limits: Transport-aircraft advisory fragment model; numerical spread angles, failure likelihood and certification conclusions are not transferred to RC aircraft.
sources.access_scope: Original advisory, especially scope and section 6.

sources.title: Blast SDK 5.0.6: Introduction
sources.supports: Authored support bonds and connectivity-based actor islands after fracture.
sources.scope_and_limits: Game destruction support graph; user-defined health is not a validated airframe stress or strength model; versioned docs were current at inspection.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: Blast SDK 5.0.6: Nv::Blast::ExtStressSolver
sources.supports: The separate stress solver takes node data and applied forces before calculating bond stress.
sources.scope_and_limits: API design example, not proof of accurate RC load redistribution or a recommendation to integrate Blast.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: Characterization load-induced cracks in balsa wood
sources.supports: Compact-tension balsa cracks generally followed grain with irregular walls and cell bridging.
sources.scope_and_limits: Article abstract on original author-institution record; only compact specimens; not all grain orientations or RC assemblies.
sources.access_scope: Original author/institution/publisher abstract or bibliographic record; full paper is not claimed.

sources.title: Residual bending behaviour of sandwich composites after impact
sources.supports: Tested glass/epoxy sandwich coupons with specific balsa, SAN and PET cores showed distinct core deformation and post-impact bending failure mechanisms.
sources.scope_and_limits: Specific engineered sandwich coupons and loading sequence, not general bare-foam or built-up RC-aircraft strengths.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: A Numerical and Experimental Study of Damage Growth in a CFRP Composite Honeycomb Sandwich
sources.authors: Mark McElroy; James Ratcliffe; Michael Czabaj; John Wang; Fuh-Gwo Yuan
sources.supports: Supported aluminum-honeycomb/cross-ply coupon under quasi-static indentation supports stable crack/delamination growth; compared continuum model did not match delamination growth well.
sources.scope_and_limits: Conference presentation and specific specimen, test and model; no RC failure thresholds or proof of universal progressive behavior.
sources.access_scope: Original NASA conference presentation; specimen, observations and conclusions.

sources.title: Compression After Impact on Honeycomb Core Sandwich Panels With Thin Facesheets: Experiments - Part 1
sources.authors: Thomas D. McQuigg; Rakesh K. Kapania; Stephen J. Scotti; Sandra P. Walker
sources.supports: Post-impact compression of thin fiberglass/Nomex panels showed different residual dent growth and crack failure modes in two tested core densities.
sources.scope_and_limits: Only two related aerospace sandwich constructions and later compression; cannot set damage progression or physical limits of an RC airframe.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: Rigid Body Collision Response
sources.supports: COM-referenced point velocity, rotated inertia tensor, linear/angular momentum and equal/opposite impulse relations.
sources.scope_and_limits: Real-time mechanics exposition, not fracture experiments or RC-specific physical validation; conservation test is an application of these relations.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: RigidBody3D — Godot Engine 4.6 documentation
sources.supports: Custom COM is relative to body origin; frequent transform or velocity writes are cautioned against.
sources.scope_and_limits: Version 4.6 API documentation is not an execution of the project engine/backend or proof of its specific velocity semantics.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: P-51 Mustang 1.50 ARF Assembly Manual
sources.supports: Model assembly uses multiple CA hinges and a separately connected aileron horn/linkage.
sources.scope_and_limits: One product assembly only; no crash load or hinge-breaking probability; not proof of this repository aircraft exact configuration.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: HingeJoint3D — Godot Engine 4.6 documentation
sources.supports: Engine interface provides a relative rotational joint, angular limits and motor settings.
sources.scope_and_limits: A joint is not a material failure criterion, and documentation is for 4.6 rather than the pinned project runtime.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: Using Jolt Physics — Godot Engine 4.6 documentation
sources.supports: Some Godot joint properties, including hinge bias, softness and relaxation, are unsupported by the documented Jolt integration.
sources.scope_and_limits: Version/backend-specific; not a claim about the project-selected backend or actual 4.8 behavior.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: Unsteady aerodynamics of fluttering and tumbling plates
sources.authors: A. Andersen, U. Pesavento and Z. Jane Wang
supports: Quasi-two-dimensional plate motion exhibits flutter and tumble, with rotational coupling and dependence on Reynolds number, inertia and thickness ratio.
sources.scope_and_limits: Experiment and numerical analysis of rigid plates near Reynolds number 10^3; does not measure RC fragments, foam, film or engines. The proposed inexpensive visual law is an engineering approximation.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: Collision shapes (3D)
supports: Primitives are recommended for dynamic-body reliability; convex shapes trade accuracy for complexity and multiple shapes add cost.
sources.scope_and_limits: Godot 4.4 documentation, not a guarantee of the application's pinned Godot 4.8 beta or its installed physics backend.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: RigidBody3D
supports: A body can sleep when not moving; continuous collision detection aims to miss fewer fast or small impacts, at additional cost.
sources.scope_and_limits: Godot 4.7 API description. Sleep, wake, CCD, support and contact behavior must be verified on the exact beta binary and platform; the docs do not guarantee no tunneling.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: Dynamics of grain ejection by sphere impact on a granular bed
sources.authors: S. Deboeuf, P. Gondret and M. Rabaud
supports: A granular impact produces an evolving ejection corona and its geometry can be compared with a ballistic ejection model.
sources.scope_and_limits: Vertical 1–4 m/s steel-sphere impacts into a dense packing of glass beads; no calibrated prediction for grass, cohesive soil, glancing scrapes or RC structures.
sources.access_scope: Original author-hosted paper read by research reviewer; lead independently checked publisher abstract and indexed original experiment text after a direct PDF timeout.

sources.title: Water entry of spheres with various contact angles
sources.authors: Nathan B. Speirs, Mohammad M. Mansoor, Jesse Belden and Tadd T. Truscott
supports: Water-entry cavity morphology and splash-crown appearance vary with experimental conditions and wettability; a splash crown is not inevitable.
sources.scope_and_limits: Original journal abstract for smooth spheres, accessed via publisher; not a hydrodynamic calibration for an RC aircraft or a justification for enabling nonterminal water contacts.
sources.access_scope: Original author/institution/publisher abstract or bibliographic record; full paper is not claimed.

sources.title: Creating a 3D particle system
supports: In Godot 4.7 conversion from GPU to CPU particles loses listed features including subemitters, trails, collision, turbulence and amount ratio.
sources.scope_and_limits: 4.7 documentation; not proof that every GPU feature is available or unavailable on any specific Compatibility renderer or beta version.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: Standard Material 3D and ORM Material 3D
supports: Proximity fade can visually soften particle intersections and alpha blending entails sorting and GPU cost; the 4.7 particle-trail material feature is documented for Forward+ and Mobile rather than Compatibility.
sources.scope_and_limits: Version-specific documentation; beta/renderer capability, image quality and cost require a live probe. Proximity fade is a shading effect and does not model physical contact.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: High-Speed, Off-Screen Particles
supports: Transparent screen coverage and overlap can dominate particle rendering; depth fade can soften intersections; reduced-resolution particle composites introduce depth and image-quality tradeoffs.
sources.scope_and_limits: Developer's historical GPU rendering approach; no direct claim of cost or feature support on this project's Godot beta and hardware.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: Particle sub-emitters
supports: Particle systems can chain subemitters; active child particles are capped by the child's configured amount, and recursive setups do not work.
sources.scope_and_limits: 4.7 feature description; subemitter operation on the pinned beta and renderer must be individually tested.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: Curl-Noise for Procedural Fluid Flow
sources.authors: Robert Bridson, Jim Hourihan and Marcus Nordenstam
supports: A velocity field constructed as the curl of a potential is divergence-free and can produce controlled fluid-like procedural detail; the paper treats boundary conditions explicitly.
sources.scope_and_limits: A full field/boundary construction. A few bounded modes used for presentation do not by themselves handle obstacles, solve fluid dynamics or validate actual smoke behavior.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.title: Fire in the Vulcan Demo
supports: The developer used procedural smoke, appearance variation and animation with practical texture-memory and smoke-lighting tradeoffs.
sources.scope_and_limits: Historical visual-effects demo; not experimental validation of crash smoke, fire chemistry or modern hardware cost.
sources.access_scope: Relevant primary-source text/abstract or official API sections; scope limitations are recorded above.

sources.authors: H.C. Jaggers, D.P. Franklin, D.R. Ward, F.G. Roper
sources.supports: Experimental fuel-gas cloud burning time depends on release and buoyancy regime; very small clouds need not be fully turbulent.
